import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
roots = [Path('products/distribution'), Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')]
rights = re.compile(r'licen[cs]e|copyright|redistribut|permission|third.party|all rights reserved|public domain|synthetic fixture', re.I)
records = []
for root in roots:
    for path in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
        if not path.is_file() or 'raw' in path.parts or path.stat().st_size > 300000:
            continue
        if root.name == 'distribution' and not re.search(r'shopify|catalogue|bundle.manifest', str(path), re.I):
            continue
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
        hits = [{'line': i, 'excerpt': line[max(0, match.start()-100):match.end()+140]} for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1) if (match := rights.search(line))][:12]
        records.append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'passages': hits})
output = Path('products/services/catalogue-gumroad/original-record-provenance-screen.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps({'scope': [str(root) for root in roots], 'records': records, 'interpretation': 'Candidate passages only. Verify grant, holder, file coverage and commercial redistribution in context. Absence of a hit does not establish prohibition.'}, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(f'{output}: screened {len(records)} records, {sum(bool(record["passages"]) for record in records)} with candidate passages')
